page_title: SHU 2-1 WOL | Sheffield Utd v Wolves 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' 2 - 1 Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) gave the goalkeeper no chance from the penalty. Jose Sa failed to reach the ball, which slid off the crossbar into the roof of the net.
90+10' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) is going to take the penalty!
90+10' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
90+9' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
90+9' Fabio Silva (Wolves) trips an opposition player and Robert Jones signals a foul. The referee blows his whistle and awards Sheffield Utd a penalty after chaos inside the box.
90+7' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) is penalised for a foul. Robert Jones had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+6' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The referee allows time for a substitution. Gustavo Hamer will be replaced by Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd).
90' Paul Heckingbottom (Sheffield Utd) gets a yellow card, off the field.
89' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
89' 1 - 1 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:1.
87' Mario Lemina (Wolves) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
87' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.
83' The corner is swung in but Sheffield Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Fabio Silva (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
81' It is time for a substitution. Fabio Silva (Wolves) is on for Toti.
80' Wolves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' The ball is out of play. Sheffield Utd win a corner kick.
77' Sheffield Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
75' Max Kilman (Wolves) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Jones interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
72' 1 - 0 Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and his effort goes in off the crossbar to give the goalkeeper no chance!
70' Substitution. Thomas Doyle will be replaced by Boubacar Traore (Wolves).
70' Craig Dawson (Wolves) commits a foul and Robert Jones immediately signals a free kick.
70' The game is interrupted. Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
66' Mario Lemina (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
64' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
61' Here comes a substitution. Sasa Kalajdzic is given a rest as he is replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).

60' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
58' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

56' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
54' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
53' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
52' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
52' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
50' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
49' Craig Dawson (Wolves) receives a yellow card for infringement.
47' Close! Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
46' The whistle blows and Robert Jones starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Paul Heckingbottom is forced to make a change. Rhian Brewster is unable to continue due to injury, James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
45+2' Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
40' Wolves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
38' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is out of play. Sheffield Utd will have a throw-in.
36' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
36' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd).
35' Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
33' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
30' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
29' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Thomas Doyle (Wolves) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
27' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is penalised for holding. Robert Jones signals a set piece.
26' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Matheus Cunha (Wolves), whose effort would probably have ended in the roof of the net.
25' Wolves couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
22' George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
21' Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Robert Jones signals.
20' Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
18' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
16' A lofted cross from Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
13' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
11' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
11' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sheffield Utd, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
10' Mario Lemina (Wolves) jumps into a tackle and Robert Jones signals a foul.
9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
5' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
2' George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) brings his opponent down. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Sheffield Utd will take the kick-off.
Robert Jones is the one to supervise the game today.
